thread:
harper: Quick pulse — were finalizing launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar landing. Need: final keyword targets, minimal JSON-LD (Event + Speaker + FAQ), internal linking map (pillars -> landing), and redirect rules. Can we assign owners by EOD?

jun: Ill own the KW refinement and anchor recommendations. Pushed a working sheet: https://tiny.example/kw-refine (columns: keyword, intent, funnel stage, priority, anchor suggestion).

maddy: I'll take the benchmark narrative copy and CTA variants (register / watch / contact). Will post hero one-liners for A/B by 17:30.

dee: I'll add schema + FAQ and QA the JSON-LD injection. Suggest keeping FAQ to 1-2 Qs. Also will add Speaker schema so search shows presenters.

seo-bot: site-scan: 6 pages with duplicate H1s, 3 missing structured event data. Crawl report: https://tiny.example/seo-scan-3851

jun: For redirects, proposal (nginx examples):
```nginx
# redirect rules
rewrite ^/old-webinar-page/?$ /webinars/inference-production-2026 permanent;
location = /resources/webinar { return 301 /webinars/inference-production-2026; }
# keep query strings for UTMs
rewrite ^/blog/2026/(.*)-webinar$ /webinars/inference-production-2026?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch permanent;
```

harper: Good. We need a canary deploy for the redirects and a rollback plan. Jun, can you include smoke-test steps in the PR?

jun: Yep. Smoke tests: curl 200/301 checks, check rel=canonical header, and verify GA event fires on register CTA. PR will include test checklist.

dee: Draft schema to drop into landing (will validate in unit tests):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar: Inference in Production","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Inference in Production","startDate":"2026-03-26T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/inference-production-2026","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/inference-production-2026"},"performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Ava Chen","sameAs":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/avachen"}},"@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Who should attend?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Platform and ML engineers building production inference."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Will there be benchmarks?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes  live demo and benchmark narrative included."}}]}]}
```

jun: Nice. For internal linking: goal = 3 contextual links from pillar article -> landing (use anchors: "inference latency", "cost per token", "production serving patterns") + 1 link from product docs. Add campaign UTMs: ?utm_source=article&utm_medium=internal_link&utm_campaign=inference_launch

maddy: Copy note: hero CTA variants: 1) "Register: See predictable LLM latency in production" 2) "Register: Lower inference cost without sacrificing quality" will run as A/B. Also need one-line subhead for SEO meta description (~155 chars). I'll post before 17:30.

seo-bot: recommendation: add rel="canonical" on the landing to itself and ensure /resources/webinar and old blog pages have canonical pointing to new landing after redirect. Also consider rel="alternate" for mobile if different content.

harper: Timeline recap: Jun - redirects PR + smoke tests by 15:00. Dee - schema + FAQ unit tests by 16:00. Maddy - copy + meta by 17:30. Final QA pass 20:00 PT. Go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT.

jun: I'll open PR and ping eng-infra for nginx reload window.

dee: I'll add a small regression eval to the QA checklist to catch title/meta regressions after canonical changes.

maddy: Thanks all. If anything changes post-PR we'll flag here. :rocket:
